outroLine: Every supplier's requirements, in one place.

beats.shot: Land on the supplier profile, Overview tab: header badges (format, channel, auto-process), KPI cards, delivery summary, recent deliveries.
beats.vo: Every supplier you send orders to has a profile like this. The header says how they receive orders — the format, the channel, and whether orders go out automatically. Below it, how the relationship is actually performing.

beats.shot: Click the Mappings tab: the saved SKU mapping table with provenance pills (AI / Manual / Inherited / Imported) and confidence.
beats.vo: Mappings are the translation table. Your item codes on one side, the supplier's on the other. And every pair carries its origin — imported, entered by hand, inherited, or suggested by AI — with a confidence score.

beats.shot: Click the Catalog tab; click Import CSV/XLSX; a catalog file arrives and product rows appear in the table.
beats.vo: The catalog is the supplier's own product list, and it's ground truth. With a catalog in place, AI suggestions only use real codes, and unknown codes are flagged. Import it from a file…

beats.shot: Expand 'Automatic import': the scheduled pull editor (SFTP/FTP/FTPS) and the push card with the supplier's HTTP API endpoint.
beats.vo: …or make it automatic. ProcuLink can pull the catalog on a schedule from an S F T P folder, or the supplier can push updates straight to an H T T P endpoint with an A P I key. The catalog stays fresh without anyone thinking about it.

beats.shot: Click PO Mapping briefly (the column-mapping spine appears), then Delivery (the channel editor appears).
beats.vo: Two more tabs do the heavy lifting. P O Mapping is how this supplier's files are read. Delivery is how finished orders reach them. Each one has its own guide.

beats.shot: Click Validation rules: active rule bindings with severity, 'blocks delivery' labels, and the how-validation-works note.
beats.vo: And validation rules are the gate — what this supplier requires on every order. Error rules block delivery until they're fixed, warnings only flag. Validation never changes the order. It only checks it.
